lin.name: Flight Console

changes: a new mono for the machine and the figures (Geist Mono, Red Hat Mono, Azeret Mono, Fira Code, Spline Sans Mono or Victor Mono)
quotes and bullets hung by hand outside the text edge (a negative indent, or the list pulled into the margin)
true small caps (font-variant-caps: all-small-caps) for labels and eyebrows instead of uppercase

lin.idea: a 1969 flight console: a readout strip across the top (TODAY, PLANS, TO DO, LATE, IDEAS), the coming weeks drawn as a flight plan of hops between stops, an annunciator of lit lamps on Status, a crew board of lamps on To do, a T-minus countdown for setup, a flight-log chat
